name: Garruk Wildspeaker
description: Garruk Wildspeaker is a huge planeswalker druid and hunter who prefers a solitary life in the wilds and was cursed by Liliana through the Chain Veil.

citations.text: "Garruk Wildspeaker". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: On Innistrad he was captured in Odric's trap, weakened and cursed, and later Avacyn wanted him brought to her cathedral before the curse made him a demon.

timeline.summary: The webcomic The Hunter and the Veil about Garruk and Liliana is published in July and August 2008.
timeline.quote: The Hunter and the Veil is a webcomic about Garruk and Liliana .

citation.text: "Eventide", section "Webcomic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The art of Mind Control shows a blue mage leaving a handprint on an undead monstrosity, like Garruk marking the defeated Ursoth.
timeline.quote: a similar image to what Garruk does when he marks the defeated Ursoth.

citation.work: A Fresh Coat of Magic Paint
citation.text: "A Fresh Coat of Magic Paint". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jul 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker admits some jungle creatures simply cannot be hunted.
timeline.quote: There are some things in the jungle that simply can't be hunted.

citation.text: Mist Leopard (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The veil-enhanced Liliana dispatches Garruk in the Onakke temple.
timeline.quote: Garruk attacked her in the temple after she had located the veil and tracked her through the hidden tunnels until he was dispatched by the veil-enhanced Liliana.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "The Hunter and the Veil". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Veil's Curse webcomic about Garruk and Jace is published in July and August 2009.
timeline.quote: The Veil's Curse is a webcomic about Garruk and Jace .

citation.text: "Magic 2010", section "Webcomic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker, when summoned by a green-aligned mage, tacitly agrees to cast spells, overrun foes and take attacks on the summoner's behalf (an explanatory flavor scenario).
timeline.quote: Garruk has tacitly agreed not only to cast some spells and overrun some faces

citation.text: "Keeping Spells Spellish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column explains that planeswalkers risk their lives in magical duels, and may retreat rather than fight to the death.
timeline.quote: She distracts her opponent and gets the hell out of there

citation.text: "Your Mailbox is Over Vorthosity". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Garruk planeswalks to Ravnica and smashes through guards and wards to reach Jace's chamber.
timeline.quote: Garruk was able to planeswalk to Ravnica, but still had to smash his way through guards and wards to get to Jace's chamber.

citation.text: "Monument to a Lost Age". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As a boy Garruk is told by his father Raklan to hide in the forest after a Sheriff of Lord Faldus comes to conscript him.
timeline.quote: Raklan told Garruk to run and hide in the forest until he told him that it was safe to return.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Years later Garruk calls a wurm that devours the Sheriff and takes his helm.
timeline.quote: Garruk had planned for that treachery and called a wurm that devoured the Sheriff.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk's spark ignites and he planeswalks for the first time, to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: his first planeswalk was to Shandalar

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk hunts the Ursoth, then rages at Liliana for killing one of his beasts and assaults her in an Onakke temple.
timeline.quote: he flew into a rage and tracked her down, assaulting her in an ancient Onakke temple

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Hunter, the Veil, and The Veil's Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses the Chain Veil to overpower and curse Garruk.
timeline.quote: Liliana overpowered him with a surge of black magic that cursed him

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Hunter, the Veil, and The Veil's Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk seeks a cure on Ravnica and overpowers Jace before coming to his senses, then learns Liliana's last location.
timeline.quote: Jace told him her last known location

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Hunter, the Veil, and The Veil's Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk calls on one of his many hornbeast alpha companions when he is in a bind.
timeline.quote: Garruk's Packleader is one of the many savage sidekicks that he calls on when the time is right.

citation.text: "Coming Home to Magic". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The columnist makes friends with the censor-bots rather than letting his inner Garruk destroy them.
timeline.quote: I did manage to not let my inner Garruk run wild and destroy the censor-bots ...

citation.work: Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk
citation.text: "Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Magic 2012 changes the planeswalker lineup: Gideon and Sorin replace Ajani and Liliana, while Jace, Chandra and Garruk return in new versions.
timeline.quote: Instead of Ajani and Liliana, we see Gideon and Sorin.

citation.text: "Core Curriculum". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana retrieves the Chain Veil from ancient catacombs, runs afoul of Garruk Wildspeaker, and defeats him, leaving him cursed.
timeline.quote: Liliana also learned the grim potency of the Chain Veil, using it to defeat Garruk, leaving him weakened and afflicted with some sort of dark curse.

citation.text: "Liliana's Mission". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Garruk tracks Liliana to Innistrad but her ghouls let her escape, and the curse overtakes him.
timeline.quote: He crossed her path once in Nephalia , but was beset by her ghouls.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's Cursemute dulls the Chain Veil's influence and temporarily frees Garruk, who chooses to keep tracking Liliana.
timeline.quote: the curse was pushed into remission, temporarily freeing Garruk

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric traps and drugs Garruk to take him to trial before Avacyn, but Garruk escapes enraged.
timeline.quote: Garruk became enraged and escaped Odric and his Riders.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess and Garruk Wildspeaker return as the new cards Liliana of the Veil and Garruk Relentless.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess returned as a new card named Liliana of the Veil .

citation.text: "Innistrad", section "Themes and mechanics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk slays Liliana's undead swarm in Nephalia, letting her escape.
timeline.quote: He slew all of the undead, but it was enough to allow Liliana to escape.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Doug considers a magical universal translator as a spark power but dislikes it.
timeline.quote: What if planeswalkers did have a magical universal translator?

citation.work: Six Ways to Fail at Creative Endeavors
citation.text: "Six Ways to Fail at Creative Endeavors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The author argues that Garruk in the graveyard is a memory, not a body, because the official story has planeswalkers leave for another plane when out of loyalty.
timeline.quote: the official story is more about planeswalkers zooming off to some other plane as soon as they run out of loyalty

citation.text: "It's Not a Discard Pile". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker tracks Liliana to Innistrad while transforming under the Chain Veil's curse.
timeline.quote: has tracked the death-witch to Innistrad.

citation.work: A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension
citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Garruk, afflicted by Liliana's curse, pursues her across Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Even as she is on Griselbrand's trail, Garruk is on hers

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana doubts the Chain Veil even as she needs it against Garruk.
timeline.quote: she is beginning to feel doubts about the wisdom of using the Chain Veil to further her death magic

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana retrieves the Chain Veil from the Shandalar catacombs as instructed by Kothophed, then uses it to destroy Kothophed and Griselbrand and pass the demon curse to Garruk.
timeline.quote: retrieved the Chain Veil from the catacombs at Shandalar

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cursemute also stifles Garruk's curse for a while.
timeline.quote: This spell is called the cursemute , and also stifled Garruk 's curse for a while.

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The creature identifies itself as Garruk Wildspeaker, weakened and cursed.
timeline.quote: "I'm weakened, cursed, and no threat to you," it said.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Enraged, Odric smashes the pommel of his sword against Garruk's temple, dropping him.
timeline.quote: Odric bashed the blunt end of his sword against the monster's temple

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete pleads that the creature is not a werewolf and proposes bringing it alive to Thraben.
timeline.quote: "Let us bring it to Thraben—alive. Leave the days of slaughter behind us.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Odric lets go of Garruk, sheathes his sword and orders him drugged and tied for the road to Thraben.
timeline.quote: "Drug him and tie him down.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Jace halts Garruk's chain veil curse by implanting a hedron in him.
timeline.quote: Jace succeeded in implanting the hedron in Garruk and halting the curse of the chain veil.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Unfinished Business". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
timeline.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
timeline.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her first visit, when she killed her horse's attacker and used the veil to infect Garruk with shadow, after which he hunted her to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She'd used it to infect him with shadow, polluting his nature magic with the touch of death.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
timeline.quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Vronos confronts the corrupted Garruk and is overwhelmed by his beasts, then wounded in the shoulder by his thrown axe.
timeline.quote: Garruk had simply hurled his weapon.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Vronos kills a doe for sustenance; Garruk finds him and swings his axe as Vronos bows his head.
timeline.quote: The axe whistled down. Vronos bowed his head.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Garruk comes to see all planeswalkers as prey and kills Vronos, taking his mask as a trophy.
timeline.quote: Vronos was quickly dispatched after a brief and disjointed clash.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Apex predator". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A suppression Hedron stops Garruk's transformation into the Worldslayer demon in the Onakke Catacomb.
timeline.quote: a suppression Hedron was used to stop Garruk's transformation into a demon

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Apex predator". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace appears to Garruk disguised as Liliana; the ruse fails and Garruk warns him off.
timeline.quote: Masking himself as Liliana, Jace once more appeared before Garruk.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Apex predator". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk beheads the ice-wielding planeswalker Icy, who had been hired by Vronos.
timeline.quote: Garruk decapitated him, noting his slowness

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Apex predator". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura and Nissa Revane replace Ajani and Garruk as the archetypal white and green planeswalkers as the Gatewatch story begins.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura and Nissa Revane replaced Ajani and Garruk as the archetypal white and green Planeswalkers, respectively.

citation.text: "Planeswalker", section "Gatewatch era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Bolas arranges to keep Garruk out of the war on Ravnica.

timeline.quote: Oko mesmerized Garruk, turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk guards the prisoners while Oko prepares to have the High King killed as a stag.
timeline.quote: he was left to guard the prisoners

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: As the hedron was removed from Garruk, the curse ran wild, driving him into a frenzy.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk is attacked by an abomination while crossing a river in the Wilds and kills it.
timeline.quote: he wrestled with the beast until he snapped its spine

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
